## Task

Implement only Task 1b from parent #454. Add a dependency-free, testable fast-reaction helper immediately after checkout and before auth, provider setup, npm install, or build. Using github.token and raw event payload fields, perform a best-effort live-mention check limited to active trigger text, stripping fenced code blocks and quoted lines, then use the appropriate REST reaction endpoint for issue/PR comments, issue/PR bodies, and PR review comments. Emit whether the early reaction succeeded and ensure the later GraphQL reaction step skips when it did, preventing duplicate reactions across identities. Leave discussions and PR review bodies on the existing post-setup GraphQL fallback. Treat reaction failures as best-effort and preserve route behavior. Add focused tests for supported endpoints, mention filtering, success/failure outputs, and fallback suppression; update relevant workflow documentation. Do not implement Task 1c, Task 2, approval-offer, metadata removal, or Task 3.
